title: Make Windows CPU monitoring less intrusive and preserve exclusive update locks until installation finishes.
changes: Measure Windows CPU utilization before starting network, disk and thermal subprocesses, reducing self-induced load in short samples on low-core-count computers.
Retain the exclusive Windows npm update-prefix lock until an asynchronous installation resolves or rejects, preventing overlapping updates from moving the same package tree.
Keep the existing Linux/macOS CPU probe order and synchronous update behavior; cover both changes with runtime and client regressions.
Preserve ReMCP 0.2.221 measured Windows network throughput and previously published safety fixes.
